newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica bolsters Madrid stocks at close.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica bolsters Madrid stocks at close.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed slightly higher in relatively thin trade on Wednesday, with a late rise in Telefonica bolstering the indices, dealers said.
Focus was on tomorrow's October CPI and corporate results.
The general index rose 0.99 points, 0.26 percent, to 388.05 and the Ibex rose 10.36 points, 0.23 percent, to 4,469.90.

Telefonica saw yet more gains, adding 50 pesetas to 2,740 after IBCA assigned high ratings to a debt programme in late trade. In any case, the stock continues bullish ahead of what are expected to be strong results, due on Friday, dealers said.

Telepizza started trade on the Madrid bourse amid strong volume, rising to 3,100 pesetas versus its 2,300-peseta placement price. The shares saw hefty demand and Telepizza accounted for 24 percent of total market volume.
Repsol added 20 pesetas to 4,315 after Wednesday's nine-month results announcement, which were broadly in line with analyst expectations.
All eyes are now on Thursday's October inflation data --estimated to rise 0.2 percent on the month-- for indications on the possibility of further Spanish rate cuts, dealers said.
